# Prioritisation templates

Every output carries status draft, version, date, an evidence table and a Gaps and open questions section, following the handoff standard.

## Criteria (written and dated before any ranking)

```
Written by: <role> | Date: <YYYY-MM-DD> | Dated before first ranking: <yes or no>

| Criterion | Meaning | Scale or threshold | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| <criterion> | <meaning> | <scale> | <source> |
```

## Priority jobs (jobs/priority-jobs.md)

```
| Job ID | Job statement | Importance | How well served today | Evidence strength | Working (how it was ranked) | On shortlist (decided by a person) | Objective it ties to | Measure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <JB-NN> | <statement> | <from the matrix> | <from the matrix> | <participants> | <working> | <blank until decided> | <objective, or none> | <measure> |

Shortlisted jobs with no objective: <list>
Receiver: the story mapping workshop (handoff H08)
```

## Feature decisions (decisions/feature-decisions.md)

```
Acceptance threshold used: <from the test plan, with file and version>
Threshold set before the test: <yes or no>
Acceptance signed by (role): <role, blank until named>

| Feature ID | Acceptance result | Meets threshold | Assumptions confirmed or rejected | Gaps found | Options with consequence (forward, change, drop) | Decision | Decided by (role) | Date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <FT-NN> | <result, from 19-analyse-test-results> | <yes or no> | <IDs> | <list> | <forward: ...; change: ...; drop: ...> | <blank until decided> | <role> | <YYYY-MM-DD> |

Receiver: detailed design (handoff H16)
```
